The balayage hair colour turned out even better than I expected. The blend was seamless, natural-looking, and added so much dimension to my hair. The stylist understood exactly what I wanted and customized the shade perfectly to suit my complexion and style.

The nano treatment made a huge difference to my hair texture. My hair feels smoother, shinier, frizz-free, and much more manageable now. The treatment gave my hair a healthy and silky finish without making it feel heavy.

Overall, the experience was excellent from start to finish. The staff was professional, skilled, and welcoming, and the salon maintained great hygiene and a relaxing atmosphere. I would highly recommend these services to anyone looking for a complete beauty and hair transformation.

featured_reviews.name: Raksha chaubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Disappointed – Worst Keratin Treatment Experience

I recently got a keratin treatment at this salon, paying a hefty 5000 INR. The experience was absolutely terrible, and I would highly recommend avoiding this place.

I booked my appointment and was attended by a person named Poonam, who claimed to be a hair expert. To my shock, she started the keratin treatment without even washing my hair, which is standard procedure. When I asked about this, she denied the need for a wash. Her staff initially told me I had to wash my hair after 48 hours, but Poonam contradicted them and said it wasn't necessary. After researching online, I found that a wash is required after 48 hours, but Poonam insisted otherwise.

She also promised that the keratin treatment would last for 3-4 months. However, just 24 hours later, my hair looked exactly the same as it did before the treatment—no difference at all! When I returned to address this, Poonam started charging me more money to "fix" the issue, even though it was her mistake. I ended up spending another 6000 INR in just two days, and my hair still looks exactly the same, if not worse.

I am beyond frustrated with the unprofessionalism of Poonam and her salon. It’s clear that they are more focused on making money than providing quality service. I don’t know how someone with such poor skills is even allowed to run a salon.

I strongly advise against going to this place. Save your money and your hair. This is by far the worst salon experience I’ve ever had.
